panel.firstrun.body: A profile describes a type of cover: how long it takes to run, how long the slats take and how the curtain winds onto the roll. Each cover may follow one, and Home Assistant adapts it to that cover's own travel.
panel.firstrun.how: A profile is not written, it is measured. Pick one representative cover and measure it once, with the guided calibration: about three minutes. Similar covers can then follow it.
panel.firstrun.note: This opens the Configure dialog: that is where the measuring happens. When it is done, the profile appears here.
panel.firstrun.title: No profile yet
